ringkas.id: Tanyakan jadwal pemeriksaan dan rincian biaya.
ringkas.en: Ask about examination times and fees.
Ask about filling options after examination.

ringkas.id: Kebutuhan tindakan dibahas bersama dokter setelah pemeriksaan.
ringkas.en: Treatment needs are discussed with the dentist after examination.

ringkas.id: Tanyakan penilaian kondisi gigi sebelum memilih perawatan.
ringkas.en: Ask about a dental assessment before choosing treatment.

penjelasan.id: Susun pertanyaan tentang jadwal, biaya dan lokasi untuk ditanyakan kepada praktik.
penjelasan.en: Prepare questions about hours, fees and location for the practice.

a.en: Confirm appointment requirements and the available practitioner before visiting.
